claims.subject: canonical-name
claims.statement: Canonical profile name is Evilnum.
claims.verification_rationale: The canonical name is mapped to a MITRE ATT&CK group ID.

claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: Evilnum was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, misp-mitre-intrusion-set, misp-threat-actor. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.
